metadata.title: Ops Team Cheat Sheet - Sick leave notification
metadata.author: Kevin Janssens

body:
Ops Team Cheat Sheet - Sick leave notification
Overview
Quick overview for new joiners in our team, written by the Warehouse Supervisor.
What to know
You only need a doctor's note if you're out for more than a week.
Source
From what HR told us last year.
Document owner
Kevin Janssens, Warehouse Supervisor
Last updated
2024-11-13
